commitNote: Pushed. d9f1a5b888067724b61b2fae46307ed56b4b1e0a is the head of branch codex/mainnet-sdk-identity-20260925 in Swarm-Official/privacy-zingolib, confirmed 2026-09-26 against the GitHub API. `cargo fetch` resolves it and actions/checkout can check it out; the four platform CI builds below did both. Its parent ef08aa252ec55f411dc937045548cd4f3f3dc664 is the revision this file named before.
chainNameNote: chainName and genesis are SwarmTestnet's, and stay SwarmTestnet's: scripts/check-swarm-sdk-pin.js reads SWARM_TESTNET_NAME and SWARM_TESTNET_GENESIS out of the pinned SDK's zingolib/src/config.rs, and d9f1a5b8 leaves both constants exactly as ef08aa25 left them. SWARM production is a separate profile in that same revision — ChainType::SwarmMainnet(SwarmMainnetGenesis) — and deliberately has no genesis constant to pin: its genesis is supplied per wallet through the `swarm-mainnet:<64 hex>` chain hint. There is nothing here for this file to record until the launch ceremony produces one.

manifest.note: Copied from the manifest so the build can check itself against it. The manifest is not in this repository; scripts/check-swarm-sdk-pin.js --manifest <path> re-reads the authoritative file when it is available, enforcing the fields that decide which chain this is and only noting drift in the generator's bookkeeping.
